Fancy Resort Restaurant with excellent service and tasty food.
Mar 2019
When looking for the Danaksara Restaurant, I was not aware that it belongs to a resort and is located inside "Furama Villas Danang". Although we were not guests of the resort and arrived by scooter at the reception, we were treated very nice of all the staff and offered an electric car ride to go to the restaurant. 

The restaurant itself is quite fancy, the atmosphere is a little bit soulless though and maybe would benefit from more decoration? The range of vietnamese dishes on the menu is big and they have an iPad with pictures of the dishes. All the food we ordered was very tasty and felt "authentic" to me. The service was exceptionally good. 
For all of this, I found the prices to be very reasonable. So if you are not on a tight budget, I absolutely can recomend the Danaksara Restaurant.

Different Vietnamese experience
